name: three_hop_circuit
title: A three-hop circuit and what each server knows
summary: The client applies three circuit layers. Each node removes its own. All three servers belong to one operator, who can correlate their observations.

nodes.title: Client
nodes.note: Chooses the entry, middle and exit from the signed routes view, verifies each hop handshake and applies one layer per hop.

nodes.title: Entry
nodes.note: Authenticates the client on its session and removes the entry layer. It knows the next hop and can infer the circuit length.

nodes.title: Middle
nodes.note: Removes the middle layer and passes the remaining exit ciphertext over its outbound link. It learns its two neighbours.

nodes.title: Exit
nodes.note: Removes the final layer, checks its egress policy and reaches the destination. It sees content the application did not encrypt.

nodes.title: Destination
nodes.note: The circuit protects the path between client and exit. Application encryption has its own trust boundary.
